description: 국토교통부_산불위험예측지도 [wildfires] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 산불발생 특성을 이용하여 침엽수, 영급 등 숲의 종류, 고도, 방위 등 입지환경, 그리고 도로, 농경지, 묘지 등으로부터의 거리를 지리정보시스템(GIS)을 통해 분석하여 제작한 예측. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 재난방재, 공공안전, 산불, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
